remarks: Enjoy the coastal lifestyle in this beautifully upgraded Niguel Coast home, offering a thoughtful blend of comfort and functionality. From the moment you enter, the open foyer and living area with high ceilings create a grand and welcoming first impression. The recently renovated kitchen features modern finishes, brand-new appliances, and a seamless connection to the family room, making it an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. The flexible floor plan includes a first-level bedroom and full bathroom, with the bedroom currently configured as a stylish home office.
